user.title: Spot Price
user.description: Fetch hourly spot prices from eupowerprices.com for a bidding zone. Pick an area from the list, or type your own. An eupowerprices API key is optional but recommended: with it the integration uses the official /v1 API instead of the public markets endpoint.

error.invalid_area_code: That is not a valid area code. Examples: SE1, NO2, DK1.
error.unknown_area: The API does not know that area code. Pick one from the list, or check which areas your key can access.

init.title: Spot Price options
init.description: Convert EUR/MWh to your end-user price per kWh (in your currency) and tune the cheap-window logic. The area can be changed here too. Leave the API key empty to use the public markets endpoint.

data.grid_fee_sek_kwh: Grid fee (per kWh, in your currency)
data.low_price_threshold_sek: Low price threshold (per kWh, in your currency)
